diagnostic_mode.prompt: What are you trying to do right now?

scope_freshness.prompt: Is this a freshly made batch or a reheated/frozen batch?

high_altitude_notice.message: High altitude can change fermentation/cooking behavior, but v4 does not yet contain altitude-specific bao adjustments. Continue with general diagnosis, but do not present altitude-specific fixes as validated.

prevention_type.prompt: What are you trying to prevent?

hypotheses.cause: proofing is progressing faster than the recipe clock because of actual dough/environment conditions

rescue_fast_proof.action: Stop using the printed time as the target. Judge the buns by plumpness, lighter feel and finger recovery. If they are already at/near ready and must wait, move the waiting batch to a cooler environment/refrigerator to slow further yeast activity rather than continuing warm proofing.

hypotheses.cause: later batches continue fermenting while steamer capacity is occupied

rescue_batch_wait.action: Cover waiting shaped buns and chill the later batch to slow proofing while earlier buns steam. Bring/hold batches according to dough state rather than adding the same room-temperature wait to every batch.

rescue_dry_dough.action: Do not compensate by repeatedly dusting in more flour. Compare measured flour/liquid weights to the source formula and make a small measured liquid adjustment if the dough is clearly stiffer/drier than intended. Record the flour brand/type because absorption differs.

rescue_beta.message: This in-progress rescue case is not yet covered by validated v4 logic. Record the exact observable state instead of improvising a fix.

spread_proof_state.prompt: Before steaming, were the buns unusually puffy/fragile, spreading while they waited, or did a finger indent fail to recover?

result_spread_overproof.test: Keep formula and steaming unchanged; steam an earlier-proof comparison batch.

result_spread_ambiguous.test: Collect dough stiffness, flour substitution and proof-state observations before choosing which single variable to test.

d_shaping_state.prompt: During shaping/pleating, did the dough feel dry/tight or tear instead of stretching smoothly?

result_d_dough_state.test: Choose one observed branch: if clearly dry/stiff, test a measured hydration correction; if not smooth/elastic, test dough-development endpoint. Do not alter proofing simultaneously.

out_of_scope_reheat.message: Frozen/reheated bao failures are a different process from first-cook diagnosis and are not included in commercial v4 core yet.
